title: Lemon Drop Salt Nic E-Liquid – White Grape 30ml
description:
Description
Indulge in the crisp, tangy fusion of sun-ripened white grapes and zesty lemonade, a tantalizing blend that evokes the essence of summer in every puff!
Lemon Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
